# M.S. Rau Antiques

> > M.S. Rau is a premier luxury antiques dealer specializing in fine jewelry, decorative arts, sculpture, and rare historical objects from the Renaissance through the Victorian era.

Founded by Bill Rau, M.S. Rau offers museum-quality antiques including Burma rubies, Renaissance cameos, Baroque religious art, and pieces with provenance from the British Royal Collection and Metropolitan Museum of Art. The gallery features works from European centers of craftsmanship including Vienna, Paris, and England, with particular expertise in 17th-19th century decorative arts.

## Key Topics

- Burma rubies
- Victorian-era jewelry
- Renaissance jewelry and cameos
- 17th-century Baroque art
- 19th-century decorative arts
- Religious and biblical art
- Antique bronze sculpture
- Art Nouveau
- Chinese export silver
- European luxury antiques
- Diamond necklaces
- Antique porcelain
- Folk art and canes
- Historical provenance pieces
- Museum-quality collectibles

## Fine Jewelry & Gemstones

- [Antique Burma Ruby and Diamond Necklace](https://rauantiques.com/products/antique-burma-ruby-and-diamond-necklace): Victorian Burma ruby (50ctw) & diamond (30ctw) necklace, circa 1880
- [Black Diamond Dangle Earrings, 22.00 Carats](https://rauantiques.com/products/black-diamond-dangle-earrings-22-00-carats): Platinum black diamond earrings, 22ctw with 0.68ctw white diamonds
- [Ruby Drop Earrings, 20.00 Carats](https://rauantiques.com/products/ruby-drop-earrings-20-00-carats): Ruby drop earrings: 20ctw rubies, 8ctw diamonds in platinum & 18K gold
- [Renaissance Cameo Pendant](https://rauantiques.com/products/renaissance-cameo-pendant): Renaissance cameo pendant with Abraham & Isaac scene, gems & enamel

## Religious & Historical Art

- [17th Century Italian Carved Marble Plaques](https://rauantiques.com/products/17th-century-italian-carved-marble-plaques): 17th-century Italian Baroque marble plaques: St. Jerome & Mary Magdalene
- [Saint Mary Magdalene on Alabaster with Pietre Dure Frame](https://rauantiques.com/products/saint-mary-magdalene-on-alabaster-with-pietre-dure-frame): 17th-century Baroque oil on alabaster: Mary Magdalene, pietre dure frame
- [Portrait of Napoléon II attributed to Johann Peter Krafft](https://rauantiques.com/products/portrait-of-napoleon-ii-attributed-to-johann-peter-krafft): Johann Peter Krafft oil portrait of Napoleon II, circa 1818
- [Queen Victoria and Prince Albert Stonemason's Mallet](https://rauantiques.com/products/queen-victoria-and-prince-albert-stonemasons-mallet): Carved mallet commemorating Queen Victoria & Prince Albert wedding, 1840

## Sculpture & Bronze

- [The Last Days of Napoléon by Vincenzo Vela](https://rauantiques.com/products/the-last-days-of-napoleon-by-vincenzo-vela): Vincenzo Vela bronze sculpture of Napoleon's deathbed, Barbedienne
